TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd brings directly relevant road and bridge delivery experience for the Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, C&W Department’s Package-IV scope, including rehabilitation/widening works and reinforced concrete bridge structures within tight seasonal constraints. We are an SECP-incorporated private limited company with active tax registrations and three years of audited financial statements, supporting disciplined project controls and statutory compliance [CO-PROFILE].

Most relevant past performance includes multiple road construction deployments for government clients: Project 15 (Provincial Government) PKR 199M completed in 7 months (2022) [CAP-015]; Project 39 (Provincial Government) PKR 163M completed in 8 months (2019) [CAP-039]; and Project 3 (Federal Government) PKR 177M delivered over 32 months (2020) [CAP-003]. These assignments evidence our ability to plan and execute earthworks, pavement-layering activities, and traffic management over extended durations [CAP-003].

On bridges/structures, we have delivered bridge engineering deployments including Project 4 (Federal Government) PKR 73M over 24 months (completed 2025) [CAP-004] and Project 40 (Federal Government) PKR 78M over 13 months (completed 2024) [CAP-040], as well as a larger international bridge engineering deployment at PKR 200M over 23 months (completed 2023) [CAP-028]. Our library does not yet evidence a completed bridge structure with a span of 60 metres or greater as prime contractor; we will address this mandatory requirement through a compliant joint venture/subcontract arrangement with an eligible bridge constructor while retaining overall project management and controls [CO-PROFILE].

We can arrange the required bid security of PKR 37 million via CDR/bank guarantee within our PKR 100M facility [CO-PROFILE]. However, our records confirm we do not currently hold ISO 14001, nor PEC constructor registration in category C-A/C-1; we will close these mandatory gaps through partnering and licensing actions prior to award [CO-PROFILE].
